 Judgment

Claimants are before this Court assailing the judgment and award dated 22.08.2015 passed by in LACA No.822/2012 by the I Additional District and sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (for short 'Appellate Court') enhancing compensation to Rs.1,30,200/- per acre for dry land, modifying the judgment and award dated 16.12.2011 passed in LAC No.177/2009 by the Senior Civil Judge Chincholi (for short 'Reference Court').

entities.text: I Additional District and sessions Judge, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellants are seeking for further enhancement.

2. Heard Sri Sakry K. S, learned counsel appearing for the appellants-claimants, Sri Sanjeev Kumar C. Patil, learned counsel for respondent Nos.1 and 2, Smt. Archana P. Tiwari, learned Additional Advocate General along with Sri F. M. Inamdar, High Court Government Pleader for the respondents.
3.
Learned counsel for the appellant placed reliance on the following decisions.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:4815 1. Mahadevi w/o Veerupakshappa Vs. the Special Land Acquisition Officer1(Mahadevi).

entities.text: Veerupakshappa Vs. the Special Land Acquisition Officer1(Mahadevi)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
2. Vithal s/o Kisanu Vs. Chief Engineer, KNNL and others2(Vithal).
4.

entities.text: Kisanu Vs. Chief Engineer, KNNL and others2(Vithal)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that this Court in Mahadevi's case for the notification of the year 1991 for the purpose of Lower Mullamari Project has awarded compensation of Rs.1,15,086/- per acre for the dry land and if escalation @ 8% per annum is taken for considered than the appellants would be entitled for compensation of Rs.2,43,182/-.

5. In Vithal's case this Court under the notification of the year 2008 for the purpose of Lower Mullamari Project has awarded compensation of Rs.2,99,160/- per acre and if de-escalation @ of 5%
per annum for 3 year for the notification of year 2005, than the appellants would be entitled for compensation of Rs.2,54,286/-.
Learned counsel for the respondents do not dispute that for the acquisition of land was for Lower Mullamari Project and the decision placed by the appellants is squarely applicable.

7. Under the 4(1) notification dated 07.04.2005 for the purpose of Lower Mullamari Project, the land is situated in Ramthirth, Chincholi Taluk, the Special Land Acquisition Officer proceeded to determine the market value by fixing the market value @ Rs.23,000/- as dry land, under the protest the reference was made, reference Court awarded compensation of Rs.1,08.500/- per acre, being Mahadevi W/O Hanmantha And Anr vs The Chief Engineer And Ors on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98257789/
3

entities.text: Mahadevi W/O Hanmantha And Anr vs The Chief Engineer And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
dissatisfied by the compensation determined by the reference Court, the appellant preferred appeal in LACA No.822/2012, the Appellate Court determined and enhance compensation @ Rs.1,30,200/-
per acre for dry land.
8. The Land acquisition Act being the beneficial legislation, the compensation which is beneficial to the claimants needs to be considered.
In Vithal's case the NC: 2024:KHC-K:4815 land was acquired under the preliminary notification dated 21.02.2008 for the construction of Lower Mullamari Project

, the compensation awarded per acre for dry land acquired is @ Rs.2,99,160/- with costs,
interest and statutory benefits.

In the instant case the land acquired under 4(1) notification dated 07.04.2005 for the same purpose, if de-escalation @ 5% for three years is taken, the claimant is entitled for compensation on the market value of the land acquired @ Rs.2,54,286/- per acre for dry land, accordingly this Court pass the following;
ORDER I.
The MSA is allowed in part with costs, interest and statutory benefits.
II. The claimants/appellants are entitled for compensation of Rs.2,54,286/- per acre for dry land as against Rs.1,30,200/- per acre.

III. For the delay caused in preferring the appeal before the Appellate Court, and NC:
2024:KHC-K:4815 before this Court, the claimants are not entitled for the interest for the said period.

Sd/-
